projects.title: AI-Based Fire-Fighting Robot (Hybrid)
projects.type: Final Year Project + National Hackathon Winner
projects.achievement: 1st Place among 1,000+ competing teams at a national-level hackathon with a fully functional live demo
projects.description: Designed and built a fully autonomous fire-fighting robot that detects fire using a multi-sensor array (flame, temperature, and gas sensors) and responds by navigating toward the fire and activating a water-spraying suppression system — all without any human intervention.
projects.how_it_works: The robot uses three types of IoT sensors: a flame sensor that detects infrared radiation from fire, a temperature sensor for heat threshold detection, and a gas sensor for smoke and combustible gas. When sensors detect abnormal readings, an AI decision logic module written in Python evaluates all three sensor inputs simultaneously and triggers the motorised navigation system to move toward the fire. Once within range, the water pump activates to suppress the fire. The entire pipeline from detection to suppression runs with minimal latency.
technical_highlights: Multi-sensor fusion: flame, temperature, and gas sensors feeding into one decision pipeline.
AI-driven threshold logic to reduce false positives and improve accuracy.
Real-time response with minimal latency from detection to water spray activation.
Hardware-software integration combining Python scripts with Arduino-based embedded systems.
Fully autonomous navigation with no remote control required during fire suppression.
projects.hackathon_story: Our team was competing against over 1,000 teams from colleges across India. We built the prototype in a short sprint, integrated hardware and software on-site, and ran a live demo in front of judges. The robot successfully detected and suppressed a controlled fire on the demo stage, earning us 1st place.
projects.research_output: Authored a complete IEEE-format conference paper and project report documenting system architecture, sensor communication protocols, test results, accuracy metrics, and deployment considerations.
projects.impact: This project demonstrates my ability to combine AI, IoT, and embedded systems into a real working product — not just a simulation or a slideshow.
